verdict.rationale: The evidence documents MCP server references, a CLI quickstart and runtime schema introspection, but nothing shows an interactive API reference or explorer with runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The CLI quickstart and `--input-schema` introspection are adjacent features (a tutorial flow and a developer tool), not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit here.
